mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk by immunosuppression, while tobramycin is an aminoglycoside antibiotic with nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity that may be exacerbated in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess baseline hearing, use tobramycin only when clearly indicated for serious infections, and maintain appropriate dosing adjustments based on renal function in patients receiving etanercept.
